contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)
CONSTANTINVS IVN (NOB C) ; CAESARVM N(O STRORVM)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, nummus of Constantine II as Caesar. Obverse: Laureate bust right. Inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN (NOB C). Reverse: Wreath around VOT/X. Inscription: CAESARVM N(O STRORVM). Reece period 16. Mint: London. Mint mark: -//PLONU. Die axis: 6 o'clock. The coin is struck a little off centre, some wear, green patina with an area of green verdigris. This coin dates to 323-324AD. Ref. RIC VII, P.115, 292. The coin is 19.10mm long, 18.25mm wide, 1.79mm thick, diameter 19.10mm and weighs 2.3g
